name: Comprehensive Metabolic Panel (CMP)
description: Standard 14-test blood panel evaluating kidney function, liver health, blood glucose, and electrolyte balance.

name: Basic Metabolic Panel (BMP)
description: 8-test blood panel checking glucose, electrolyte levels, and renal filtration.

name: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with Differential
description: Measures red cells, white cells, platelets, and screens for infection or anemia.

name: Routine Venipuncture (Blood Draw)
description: Collection of venous blood via needle puncture. Billed once per patient collection encounter.

name: Albumin; Serum, Plasma, or Whole Blood
description: Assay testing liver protein synthesis. Bundled under CMP (80053).

name: Alkaline Phosphatase
description: Liver and bone enzyme evaluation. Bundled under CMP (80053).

name: Emergency Department Visit - Level 1
description: Emergency department evaluation. The billed level depends on the documented medical decision making; the code alone does not establish severity or a diagnosis.

name: Emergency Department Visit - Level 2
description: Emergency department evaluation. The billed level depends on the documented medical decision making; the code alone does not establish severity or a diagnosis.

name: Emergency Department Visit - Level 3
description: Emergency department evaluation. The billed level depends on the documented medical decision making; the code alone does not establish severity or a diagnosis.

name: Emergency Department Visit - Level 4
description: Emergency department evaluation. The billed level depends on the documented medical decision making; the code alone does not establish severity or a diagnosis.

name: Emergency Department Visit - Level 5
description: Emergency department evaluation. The billed level depends on the documented medical decision making; the code alone does not establish severity or a diagnosis.

name: Chest X-Ray - 2 Views (Frontal & Lateral)
description: Standard two-view imaging of lungs, heart silhouette, and thoracic cage.

name: X-Ray Wrist - Complete (Minimum 3 Views)
description: Diagnostic radiographic evaluation of wrist bones and carpal alignment.

name: CT Scan - Head/Brain without Contrast
description: Computed tomography scan of head to rule out intracranial hemorrhage or acute trauma.

name: Electrocardiogram (ECG/EKG) with Routine Interpretation
description: 12-lead electrical tracing evaluating cardiac rhythm and ischemic changes.

name: Therapeutic/Diagnostic IV Push Injection (Initial Substance)
description: Direct intravenous push administration of an initial medication.

name: Intravenous Hydration Infusion (Initial up to 1 Hour)
description: IV administration of saline/electrolytes for rehydration.

name: Infusion, Normal Saline Solution, 1,000 cc
description: 1 Liter bag of sterile 0.9% sodium chloride IV fluids.

name: Application of Short Arm Splint (Forearm to Hand)
description: Static immobilization splint applied to forearm/wrist for fracture stabilization.
